$comment: Electron advisories that may ship anyway, each with the reason and the issue that decided it. Checked by scripts/auditShippedRuntime.mjs (npm run audit:runtime) in the release workflow. See #998.

Entry shape: { "id": "GHSA-xxxx-xxxx-xxxx", "reason": "why it cannot reach SimLauncher", "issue": 123 }. The script header says when an entry is appropriate. An entry missing its reason or issue fails the gate, and one that no longer matches a reported advisory is a warning to delete it.
